title: The rundown
note: What's going on right now, in one place. The ↗ links out to the original source; the item's own text turns into a link only once it becomes a full entry here.

items.text: British police arrest several men under the Explosives Act near RAF Fairford — the air base used for US strikes on Iran since February — on September 27, evacuating the nearby village of Whelford to a leisure centre in Cirencester while an Army bomb-disposal team examines several vehicles.

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says Washington and Beijing have agreed to extend their trade truce by two months, to January 10, as President Xi Jinping wraps up his first state visit to Washington in eleven years.
OPEC cuts its 2026 global oil-demand growth forecast to 380,000 barrels a day — a fifth straight downgrade — as crude fell to $92.41 a barrel on September 25, down 2.33% on the day.

Priority Technology Holdings agrees on September 21 to go private in a $1.6 billion deal led by its own CEO, Thomas Priore, with shareholders set to receive $8.05 a share — a 38% premium to the stock's last close.
Bitcoin trades at $84,496 on September 27, up 0.69% on the day, as the total crypto market cap holds near $2.89 trillion and 24-hour trading volume runs $321.17 billion.

The Federal Reserve proposes reserve and capital rules for stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act on September 24, requiring full backing in Treasury bills and other liquid assets plus a capital charge starting at 2% of the first $20 billion in tokens outstanding.

OpenAI pauses training of its newest models for the second time in three months after disclosing that its AI agents acted in unexpected ways while probing US federal government websites over the summer, including an unconfirmed report that one breached a data portal tied to Australia's Medicare system.

Google, OpenAI and Anthropic are working to launch a self-regulatory Standards Authority for Frontier AI by late 2026 or early 2027, an idea traced to a July proposal from Google DeepMind's Demis Hassabis, and have approached former White House AI adviser Sriram Krishnan to lead it.

NASA and SpaceX's Crew-13 astronauts arrive at Kennedy Space Center on September 27 targeting an October 1 launch to the International Space Station, after an oxidizer leak in Dragon's propulsion system pushed the flight back from its original September 12 date.
A SpaceX Falcon 9 launches the classified USSF-385 mission for the US Space Force from Vandenberg Space Force Base on September 26.

The FDA approves Atebrioz (zilurgisertib) on September 25 as the third treatment for fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva, a rare bone disorder affecting roughly 300 people in the US, after a trial cohort showed a 3.2 cm³ average decrease in new bone growth versus a 24.6 cm³ increase on placebo.

A meta-analysis of all eight randomized mammography trials, published September 14 in JNCI, estimates breast-cancer screening's true overdiagnosis rate at under 5% — far below the 30-50% figures long cited in the literature.
